description: The Price of Wall Street: every merger proxy (DEFM14A) with a fairness opinion in the last 12 months, read from SEC EDGAR. Each financial adviser's fee as the filing states it (estimate, maximum or contracted; opinion fee, closing-contingent part, credited fees never added twice), valuation methods and discount rates, with the passage. Arguments: adviser (optional, e.g. "Goldman Sachs") returns that adviser's engagements; company (optional) returns that deal; years (optional, 3 or 10) returns the year-by-year history; limit (default 25).
name: get_wall_street_fees
title: wall street fees
